sources.title: Tantivy 0.26.2 tokenizer documentation
sources.release_or_commit: tantivy 0.26.2
sources.locator: Module tokenizer; default, raw, en_stem, custom tokenizer sections
sources.observed_operation: Web search result and documentation excerpt inspected; no code run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Default tokenizer splits on punctuation and whitespace, lowercases, and drops tokens longer than 40 characters. en_stem adds English stemming. Tokenizers are selected by text field; custom tokenizers can be registered.
sources.applicability: Tantivy is a Rust full-text engine candidate. Its built-ins do not establish language-aware segmentation for every script; select analyzers explicitly and test query/index parity.

sources.title: Tantivy 0.26.2 IndexWriter documentation
sources.release_or_commit: tantivy 0.26.2
sources.locator: IndexWriter::commit, ::rollback, ::delete_term
sources.observed_operation: Web search result and documentation excerpt inspected; no code run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Adds and deletes become visible on commit. A delete affects previously committed documents and documents added earlier in the same commit; rollback returns to the last commit.
sources.applicability: Tantivy can publish a complete new version after successful extraction, but index publication and notebook metadata need an explicit coordination strategy.

sources.title: Tantivy issue: Multi-Language Index?
sources.release_or_commit: Issue #2619, opened 2025-04-09; observed open in source page/search result on access date
sources.locator: Issue question about indexing mixed language documents including Japanese and Chinese
sources.observed_operation: Official project issue search result inspected; no code run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Issue documents an unresolved design question about mixed-language indexing and tokenizers; it is not a guarantee of a product limitation or feature status beyond the observed issue.
sources.applicability: Supports treating multilingual analyzers as a validation/selection decision instead of assuming one default tokenizer handles all languages.

sources.title: Lindera tokenizer integration for Tantivy

sources.observed_operation: Official crate documentation/search excerpt inspected; no code run.

sources.title: SQLite FTS5 documentation
sources.release_or_commit: SQLite FTS5 documentation, accessed 2026-10-12; docs do not expose a pinned SQLite build in this page
sources.locator: Sections 4.3.1 unicode61, 4.3.3 porter, 4.3.4 trigram, external/contentless tables
sources.observed_operation: Official SQLite documentation search result and page excerpts inspected; no database opened or query run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Default unicode61 uses Unicode 6.1 categories and removes Latin-script diacritics by default; porter is English-specific; trigram enables substring matching but queries shorter than three Unicode characters do not match via trigram full-text search.
sources.applicability: Embedded lexical/search candidate with potentially simple metadata co-transaction. Its exact tokenizer behavior and build availability must be verified for the selected SQLite build; CJK segmentation and script-specific recall need tests.

sources.title: SQLite forum report on Polish Ł tokenization
sources.release_or_commit: SQLite forum discussion 2020-05-11 / maintainer reply 2021-01-11; release context 3.30.1 in report
sources.locator: Initial report and maintainer explanation of Unicode decomposition behavior
sources.observed_operation: Official SQLite forum page search result excerpt inspected; no reproducer run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The discussion explains that Ł/ł has no canonical decomposition to L/l plus a mark in the Unicode data used by unicode61, so remove_diacritics does not fold it as the reporter expected.
sources.applicability: Concrete warning that diacritic removal is not universal transliteration; avoid promising multilingual equivalence from unicode61 and retain original spellings.

sources.title: lopdf 0.45.0 Document API
sources.release_or_commit: lopdf 0.45.0
sources.locator: extract_text_chunks_with_limit and extract_text_with_limit
sources.observed_operation: Official docs.rs release documentation search excerpt inspected; no PDF parsed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Limited methods bound decompressed page content and return a memory-limit error for an over-limit page; the ordinary extraction counterpart is not bounded by this parameter.
sources.applicability: Page-at-a-time extraction is a modest digital-PDF path with page-only locators and explicit decompression caps. No text layer means no text is yielded; scans require separate OCR.

sources.title: Tesseract command-line usage: TSV output
sources.release_or_commit: Official tessdoc main page, version not pinned in URL; current release notes separately list 5.5.3 (2026-07-24)
sources.locator: TSV output example and columns level/page/block/paragraph/line/word, left/top/width/height/confidence/text
sources.observed_operation: Official Tesseract documentation search excerpt inspected; no OCR command run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: TSV is requested by the tsv config; its coordinates are on the OCR image canvas and require a tested mapping to PDF displayed coordinates after raster scale/rotation/crop.
sources.applicability: Offline OCR can yield word/page boxes for scanned pages; retain source as OCR-derived and expose page-only until coordinate transformation is validated.

sources.title: ECMA-376 Office Open XML File Formats standard page
sources.release_or_commit: 5th edition, December 2021; Part 2 adopted in the latest edition; other parts listed at their cited 2015/2016 editions
sources.locator: Standard scope and parts list
sources.observed_operation: Official Ecma standard page search result excerpt inspected; no package parsed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The standard defines OOXML vocabularies, document representation, packaging, and consumer/producer requirements; the listed parts have distinct editions.
sources.applicability: Basis for an optional PPTX package reader. An implementation must follow package relationships and namespaces and scope which slide content kinds it actually reads.

sources.title: quick-xml 0.42.0 Reader documentation
sources.release_or_commit: quick-xml 0.42.0
sources.locator: Reader namespace behavior and DecodingReader note
sources.observed_operation: Official docs.rs release documentation search excerpt inspected; no XML parsed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Reader is a streaming UTF-8 event reader and does not resolve namespace prefixes; use namespace-aware reading for namespaced OOXML. Non-UTF-8 input requires the encoding feature and decoding adapter.
sources.applicability: A direct PPTX parser needs bounded ZIP member reads plus namespace-aware streaming XML and explicit supported-content tests.

sources.title: zip 8.6.0 ZipFile documentation
sources.locator: ZipFile::size, ::compressed_size, ::enclosed_name warning
sources.observed_operation: Official docs.rs release documentation search excerpt inspected; no archive read.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Entry names may contain absolute paths or traversal; enclosed_name is recommended if extracting to paths. size and compressed_size expose declared values but streaming byte caps remain needed.
sources.applicability: PPTX is a ZIP package; avoid writing package members to user-selected paths and enforce both declared and actual byte/entry limits.

sources.title: W3C WebVTT specification
sources.release_or_commit: W3C WebVTT specification page observed 2026-10-12
sources.locator: Cue timing: start/end offsets; cue overlap/order; timestamp requirements
sources.observed_operation: W3C specification search excerpt inspected; no transcript parsed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Cue end must be later than its start; cues can overlap and are listed by start time; timestamps are offsets for the cue block.
sources.applicability: User-supplied VTT can support cue text with a start/end time locator. Validate malformed timing; do not fabricate times for transcripts without cues.

sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The changelog says 0.44 added bounded text/stream/load decompression and tests, and 0.45 added additional parser bounds/crash fixes. It does not prove all PDF attacks are eliminated.

sources.title: Tesseract regression fix PR #4136
sources.release_or_commit: Merged 2023-10-05 as commit 063ad31; fix targets regression from commit 842cca1 and issue #4014
sources.locator: PR description and merged commit; regression cause was signed layout scores converted to unsigned; fix included in 5.3.3 per issue/release history
sources.observed_operation: Opened official pull request and inspected maintainer fix description and merge metadata; no OCR/test run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: This PR fixes a specific layout-detection regression; the inspected PR shows one merged commit and does not establish broad OCR accuracy or a universal fixture suite.
